Privacy policy

RevTimeline (revtimeline.tech) is a project-history application. This page explains what information it stores, why, where, and how you can have it deleted. RevTimeline is free while in preview and has no advertising or analytics.

Using RevTimeline without an account

If you choose "Try it without an account", your projects are saved only in your browser on that device. They are never sent to RevTimeline. Clearing your browser's site data removes them, so use Export backup to keep a copy.

What we store when you create an account

  • Account details: your email address, the name you enter (optional), and your password, which is stored only in hashed form by our sign-in provider. If you sign in with Google or LinkedIn, we receive your name, email address and profile picture link from that service.
  • Your workspace: the projects, tasks, events, dates and commercial details (such as customer, value, VAT rate and payment terms) that you enter.
  • Technical records: our service providers keep standard logs, such as IP addresses and request times, to run and secure their services.

Your browser also keeps your sign-in session, a copy of your workspace so the app opens quickly and works offline, and your day or night setting. This information stays on your device; it is not a tracking cookie.

How we use it

Only to provide RevTimeline: to sign you in, to keep your projects in sync across your devices, and to send emails you need for your account, such as confirming your email address or resetting your password. We do not send marketing emails, sell your information, or use your projects for anything else.

Who processes it for us

  • Supabase stores accounts and workspaces and provides sign-in.
  • Resend delivers account emails from no-reply@revtimeline.tech.
  • GitHub Pages serves the website.
  • Google and LinkedIn are involved only if you choose to sign in with them.

These providers may process information outside your country under their own policies.

How your workspace is protected

Connections use HTTPS. Database rules allow each account to read and change only its own workspace; other users cannot see it.

Keeping and deleting your information

We keep your account and workspace while your account exists. You can download a full copy at any time with Export backup. To delete your account and workspace, email us from the address you signed up with; we delete them within 30 days. Copies kept by service providers for backups are removed on their normal schedules.

Your choices

You can ask us to tell you what we hold about you, to correct it, or to delete it. RevTimeline is not intended for children.

Changes

If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page. Significant changes will be announced in the app.
